statement: Implement a stack as a singly linked list. The head node is the top of the stack, so push and pop only touch the head and there is no fixed capacity.

Process the operations in order. They are given as one string, operations, separated by semicolons. "push V" adds a new head node holding V. "pop" removes the head node, or reports an underflow if the stack is empty. "peek" reads the head value without removing it.
After the last operation, return the number of nodes left on the stack.

examples.explanation: peek reads 30. The pops then remove 30, 20, 40 and 10, so the chain ends empty.
The first pop and the first peek find the stack empty. It ends as 7 → 6, with 7 at the head.
